title: TJ’s Brute Glute Hoot
author: Josiah M.
desc: Muscle growth of the gluteus maximus

ex.note: Use barbell. Wide stance with toes pointed out at 45 degrees. Go down until hamstrings touch your calves
Don’t lockout
Use cable handle to keep balance. DB in opposite hand to front leg. Step back off step and touch shoelaces on ground, but no weight on back foot
10 pulses at end of each set
At end of each set drop the DB and do half reps until failure. Don’t lockout

ss.note: AMRAP on first set. Each set after that complete same number of reps as first set (taking breaks when you need to)
